note: Background A/B tests (src/backgrounds.js). Variant A is always the background in use (BG in src/art-extra.js, from tools/art_extra.py) and is never changed by a test. A pack variant is a layered parallax background whose files and layer order come from its manifest (art/manifests/<pack>.json). build.py builds a pack in only when its manifest and every layer file it lists are committed; without them the variant does not exist and everyone sees A.
webpNote: A pack with "webp": {"quality": q} is built from WebP copies of its PNG layers (tools/art_bg_webp.py, in webp/ next to the exports): the PNGs stay the lossless masters for a PC build. A stale or missing WebP falls back to its PNG with a warning from build.py.
testsNote: tests.<bg key> (the bg of a region in world.json): variants maps a letter to a pack id; share = how installs are split when live (a variant with 0 is never drawn, it can only be previewed with ?ozadje=<letter>); live: false = nobody is assigned a variant (A for all); live: true = each install gets one variant by share, kept in localStorage zg-ab. Turning live on is the Game Director's call.
packsNote: packs.<id>: manifest path; name (shown in Liki in karte → Ozadja); hideRoad (the pack brings its own ground, so the road strip of variant A is hidden); view {width, height} = the canvas the scene is fitted to, when the art's own canvas does not suit the scene; and per layer id: x, y, scale = where the layer is placed on that canvas (canvas pixels, for a manifest that leaves placement open); speed = how fast a tiling layer scrolls compared with the road while the party walks (1 = with the road); pan = how far a layer that does not tile moves across a region (1 = from the centre to its right edge); drift = steady sideways motion of a tiling layer in canvas pixels per second (negative = to the right), off under reduced motion. Layers that must stay together share their values. All are PROPOSED values tuned in the browser against where the game stands its actors (enemies' feet at 62–70 % of the scene height, heroes' at 75–87 %), not art specifications.
